newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Carter Holt won't comment on CSR talk.
newsitem.headline: Carter Holt won't comment on CSR talk.

text.p: International Paper controlled Carter Holt Harvey and CSR Ltd on Wednesday declined to comment on speculation that CHH was poised to buy CSR's $A1 billion timber products business, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Wednesday.
The Sydney Morning Herald reported that CHH could be close to a deal, saying the company had indicated a desire to expand its operations in Australia, particularly in medium density fibreboard (MDF).
CHH last year paid the South Australian government $A130 million for timber processor Forwood Products.

"We've been reviewing our timber businesses, as we do with all our other businesses from time to time, and looking at the options. Obviously sale is one option, but there are other things that can be done too," Rodgers said.

He said CSR's timber business was said in the last annual report to employ funds of $A740 million, but the additional capital required to complete the Oberon project would take it closer to to $A1 billion.
